observable.name: Radial Acceleration Relation
observable.definition: mu(g_bar) = g_obs / g_bar, evaluated as a function of baryonic acceleration g_bar over the deep-MOND and transition regimes
observable.target: The BE-argument exponent alpha: linear g/a0 (alpha=1) versus square-root sqrt(g/a0) (alpha=1/2)
observable.proxy_status: RAR is a galactic proxy for the screening exponent; it does not directly measure a BE occupation number

raw_data: resolved gas/H I and/or molecular-gas maps
instrument: photometric and gas-kinematic instruments for the baryonic mass model
measurer: estimate g_obs from the rotation curve, with its full measurement covariance
construct g_bar from the baryonic mass model using Newtonian gravity, including distance, inclination, gas-mass and stellar M/L nuisance treatment
measurement_chain.target: alpha in the BE screening argument
measurement_chain.proxy: velocities plus baryonic model -> (g_obs, g_bar) -> mu(g_bar) -> likelihood comparison of the two fixed exponent forms

dataset.candidate: SPARC rotation-curve sample with its matched photometry and gas data
required_freeze: exact SPARC release/version and all included galaxies
quality cuts, radial range, treatment of covariance and upper limits
whether the full sample is fit or a pre-declared train/holdout split or cross-validation is used
independent source or prior for stellar M/L, plus fixed treatment of distance, inclination and gas mass
dataset.current_status: Dataset family is identified, but the exact analysis sample and split/cuts are not frozen in the proposal

statistic.required: A pre-specified hierarchical likelihood for the observed rotation-curve data (or an explicitly specified likelihood for mu at each radius), with the identical nuisance model for both exponents; report Delta ln L = ln L_sqrt - ln L_linear and a pre-declared goodness-of-fit/holdout score
statistic.null_hypothesis: The linear exponent model alpha=1 describes the RAR at least as well as the square-root model alpha=1/2
statistic.decision_rule: Reject the square-root form only if the linear form wins by a threshold fixed before fitting or the square-root form fails a pre-declared goodness-of-fit criterion; report two-sided model comparison rather than assuming an EFC winner
statistic.current_specification_gap: The proposal names Delta ln L or an equivalent statistic but does not yet freeze the exact likelihood, threshold, covariance treatment, multiple-testing rule, or holdout score

discriminators.null_hypothesis: H0: the linear BE exponent alpha=1 describes the RAR at least as well as the square-root exponent alpha=1/2; equivalently, the test must compare the two fixed forms under the same data and nuisance treatment

frozen.forms: Both competing functional forms are stated
frozen.a0: NOT FROZEN: 1.2e-10 m/s^2 appears in the papers/code, while 6.5e-10 m/s^2 and a0,eff=C^2*a0 are also in circulation
frozen.status: Invalid as a preregistered retrodiction until exactly one canonical a0 is author-frozen before any fit; a0,eff must be separately labelled if retained

prereg_required: author-freeze the canonical a0 and prohibit refitting it
freeze the exact SPARC release, galaxy/sample inclusion, quality cuts, radial range and train/holdout or cross-validation rule
freeze an independent M/L value or an explicit prior and the nuisance treatment for distance, inclination and gas mass
freeze the likelihood, covariance/error model, aggregation level, goodness-of-fit statistic, Delta ln L direction, threshold and any multiplicity correction
freeze the implementation and residual diagnostics before inspecting the data
validity_blockers: multiple incompatible a0 values remain in circulation; this converts the claimed retrodiction into an adjustable fit
stellar M/L is a dominant model-laden nuisance and is not yet frozen
exact sample, cuts, covariance model, likelihood, threshold and holdout rule are incomplete
the result would test a galactic proxy and cannot by itself select the Gamma(rho) axis or establish a paradigm-free result
the unresolved provenance of the earlier >=5-sigma SPARC claim cannot substitute for this preregistered test

discriminators.axis: Axis 2: propagation distance, gravitational-wave standard sirens

observable.name: Standard-siren luminosity-distance ratio
observable.definition: r(z) = d_L^GW / d_L^EM for the same host-identified source, as a function of redshift
observable.target: A propagation-sector deviation from equality, with candidate EFC relation r(z)=sqrt(F(phi_0)/F(phi_z)) and F(phi)=1+alpha*phi
observable.proxy_status: The ratio is near-direct, but d_L^GW and d_L^EM are separate inferred quantities with instrument and astrophysical systematics

raw_data: EM data and calibrators used for the electromagnetic distance estimate
instrument: GW detector network and amplitude calibration
optical/IR imaging and spectroscopy for host and redshift
the explicitly named EM distance-calibration data/instrument chain
measurer: infer d_L^GW from the waveform amplitude with the declared waveform, inclination, calibration, lensing and peculiar-velocity model
infer d_L^EM from redshift and the pre-declared distance-ladder or standard-candle/standard-siren EM calibration, retaining its covariance
measurement_chain.proxy: two separately inferred luminosity distances -> event-level ratio -> hierarchical population statistic

dataset.candidate: A public, explicitly versioned multi-messenger standard-siren sample with GW strain/posterior products and host-identified EM counterparts; the proposal does not name a final release
required_freeze: exact GW catalog/release, event list and posterior products
host-identification and redshift criteria, EM counterpart/distance estimator and calibration release
event-selection cuts, redshift range/binning, observing period and frequency band
treatment of lensing, peculiar velocities, waveform systematics, calibration uncertainty and selection effects
pre-declared holdout or split if the sample size permits
dataset.current_status: No exact dataset, event list or release is frozen; the test remains a proposal

statistic.required: A pre-specified event-level hierarchical likelihood for the joint GW and EM distance posteriors, including selection and declared nuisance priors; compare H0 r(z)=1 with the frozen EFC r_EFC(z) and report the likelihood ratio (or Delta chi-square/Bayes factor chosen in advance) plus a posterior/predictive goodness-of-fit check
statistic.null_hypothesis: H0 (GR/LambdaCDM propagation null): r(z)=1 at every redshift
statistic.decision_rule: Reject H0 only at a pre-declared combined-significance/evidence threshold after nuisance and selection treatment; test the EFC curve only if its parameters and phi normalization are numerically frozen before data analysis
statistic.current_specification_gap: The proposal says a combined-significance threshold but does not freeze the exact likelihood, estimator, threshold, selection correction, or EFC parameter values

discriminators.null_hypothesis: H0: d_L^GW=d_L^EM, or r(z)=1 for all redshifts; a deviation can reject equality but does not identify the internal EFC motor-lag eta without a separately declared mapping

frozen.observable: r(z) and equality null are stated
frozen.formula: The closed-form candidate r=sqrt((1+alpha*phi_0)/(1+alpha*phi_z)) is present in code/metadata
frozen.numeric_prediction: NOT FROZEN: alpha, phi_0, phi normalization and their redshift evolution are not fixed; source defaults are illustrative
frozen.status: Not a valid numeric EFC preregistration until the coupling parameters and field normalization/evolution are frozen; it can presently be registered only as a null-constraint test

prereg_required: choose and freeze the exact GW/EM catalog release, event list, host/redshift criteria and EM distance estimator
freeze alpha, phi_0, phi normalization and phi(z) evolution, or explicitly register the test as null-only rather than claiming a numeric EFC prediction
freeze event selection, redshift bins/range, frequency range, waveform model, calibration treatment and selection function
freeze nuisance priors/treatment for lensing, peculiar velocities, host misidentification, waveform and EM calibration systematics
freeze the hierarchical likelihood, evidence/statistic, combined-significance threshold, holdout rule and missing-data handling
validity_blockers: the EFC formula has no numerically frozen parameterization, so a null result cannot yet be compared to a unique EFC curve
the exact dataset and event-selection protocol are unspecified
the EM distance ladder/calibration and GW waveform/instrument systematics must be specified without post hoc tuning
the proposed statistic and decision threshold are not fully defined
a detected mismatch would test propagation distance only; F5 (eta_grav versus motor lag) remains an undeclared causal mapping
